verdict.rationale: Buzz ships an official CLI (crates/buzz-cli). Its README documents concrete commands for channels, repos branch protection, workflows and GIF search. The CLI is also the agent-native surface: the ACP harness has agents reply through it, and a packaged 'buzz-cli' skill teaches agents to use it for messaging, channels, workflows, repos and memory. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working, documented installation/distribution and release versioning for the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: buzz repos protect set --id my-repo --ref refs/heads/main --push admin --no-force-push --no-delete
The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
relay operations: owner-reviewed agent drafts, messaging, channels, DMs, users, workflows, feed, reactions, canvas, social, repos, uploads, and agent memory.
